text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(Carrying the club's hopes. Carrying 
Hayahide's hopes. 
Bearing my Trainer's expectations, I run.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(—And yours as well, Brian. 
Taking on even your expectations 
unbidden—!!)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching Phalaenopsis run, my fist 
clenched tight. 
—The Shuka Sho was ours. I was certain of 
it.

text_block_list.name: Female Club Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Amazing... Winning just one G1 is already 
incredible! But even here, she's—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaah!)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ————Well done.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Do you see? This is not something I 
accomplished alone. 
Nor did you achieve it by yourself.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: We achieved this together.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Covered in sweat and mud, we braved the 
height of summer. 
Beyond the bitter cup we drank, we have 
claimed our victory.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Let us take pride, side by side.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My eyes blurred with tears as I looked at 
Phalaenopsis. 
After hurriedly wiping them away, I gave 
her a round of applause.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I was overcome with joy. 
That I could play a part in this future. 
That I was able to 
help her deliver a run that made us both 
so proud.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That was an incredible run! So powerful, 
yet 
so graceful... I couldn't take my eyes off 
her!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Phalaenopsis is from that club surrounded 
by all that 
gorgeous nature, right? 
Maybe I'll keep an eye out for the other 
girls from that club from now on.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(At last, I can see its outline. 
The outline of that future—"the most 
beautiful garden.")

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(This is right. If I continue along this 
path, it lies ahead. 
The vista I long for, the one I wish to 
bring to our club.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: (Surely, that future is not far off now.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Tch. 
Shouldering that without my permission.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...When you get back, I'm taking it back.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —That belongs to me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer. 
What shall our next step be?
choice_data_list:
...About that, there's something I want to 
talk to you about.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From her debut to the Shuka Sho, for the 
sake of her goal, 
Phalaenopsis had pushed herself 
relentlessly without rest.
choice_data_list:
—So let's slow down the pace for a bit 
around here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking to Phalaenopsis's future, 
keeping her engine running at full 
throttle like this was dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before she burned through all her energy 
and wore herself down, 
I decided we should take a breather right 
about now... 
and aim to produce results again after 
that.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, I see. 
There is truth in what you say.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Conveniently, there are no Tiara Route 
races 
in the near future. There is no need to 
rush.
choice_data_list:
So let's make our next race the Milers 
Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Milers Cup would be held in late April 
next year. 
She would conserve her strength until then 
before returning to the front lines.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Very well. 
All so that I may continue to run 
through the Twinkle Series, correct?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Let us do this, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To make our club the most beautiful 
garden"— 
If we kept going like this, that dream was 
within her reach.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Or at least, so I thought at the time.
